title: A methylome-derived m 6 -dAMP trigger assembles a PUA-Cal-HAD immune filament that depletes dNTPs to abort phage infection
authors: Zhang Z; Wu Y; Lee Y; Nicastro GG; Chakravarti A; Fang H; Taverner D; Weigele P; Aravind L; Patel DJ; Nobrega FL
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌PUA-Cal-HAD免疫丝状体通过结合m6-dAMP耗竭dNTP抗噬菌体，属于蛋白-小分子核苷酸互作，非蛋白质-DNA结合建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Bacteria must distinguish phage attack from normal homeostatic processes, yet the danger signals that trigger many defence systems remain unknown. Here, we show that a PUA-Calcineurin-CE–HAD module from Escherichia coli ECOR28 confers broad anti-phage protection by binding Dam-methylated deoxyadenosine monophosphate (m 6 -dAMP) generated during phage-induced chromosome degradation. Ligand binding converts a preassembled PUA-Calcineurin-CE hexamer loaded with six HAD phosphatases into a polymerising filament. The filament acts as a high-flux dNTP sink through a two-enzyme cascade: HAD first dephosphorylates dATP to dADP, and Calcineurin-CE then converts dADP to dAMP. dNTP collapse halts phage replication and enforces abortive infection. Multiple mobile-element DNA mimic proteins block filament assembly, revealing a direct phage counter-defence. More broadly, our findings extend a conserved, cross-kingdom paradigm of immune filament assembly to nucleotide-depletion antiviral defence and suggest modified-nucleotide sensing by related PUA-Calcineurin-CE modules as a widespread, underappreciated bacterial strategy.
abstract_zh: 细菌必须区分噬菌体攻击与正常稳态过程，然而触发许多防御系统的危险信号仍然未知。在此，我们表明来自大肠杆菌ECOR28的PUA-Calcineurin-CE–HAD模块通过结合噬菌体诱导的染色体降解过程中产生的Dam甲基化脱氧腺苷单磷酸（m⁶-dAMP），赋予广谱抗噬菌体保护。配体结合将预组装的、装载有六个HAD磷酸酶的PUA-Calcineurin-CE六聚体转化为聚合丝状体。该丝状体通过双酶级联反应充当高通量dNTP汇：HAD首先将dATP去磷酸化为dADP，随后Calcineurin-CE将dADP转化为dAMP。dNTP耗竭阻止噬菌体复制并强制流产感染。多种移动元件DNA模拟蛋白阻断丝状体组装，揭示了一种直接的噬菌体反防御机制。更广泛地说，我们的发现将免疫丝状体组装的保守、跨王国范式扩展到核苷酸耗竭抗病毒防御，并提示相关PUA-Calcineurin-CE模块对修饰核苷酸的感知是一种广泛存在但未充分认识的细菌策略。
